name: ATM Version Report 1
definition: Information related to a configuration stored on a terminal.

ConfigurationVersion.name: Configuration Version
ConfigurationVersion.definition: The non-active configuration version which is being reported.

ConfigurationStatus.name: Configuration Status
ConfigurationStatus.definition: The status of the non-active configuration. This can be either: ‘Fail’ (i.e. the configuration update has failed), or ‘AwaitingActivation’ (i.e. the configuration download was successful and is now awaiting a future activation date).

FailReason.name: Fail Reason
FailReason.definition: The reason a configuration update has failed on the terminal.
